messages:
anya: Noticed a weird bump in p99 on the latency dashboard for a few endpoints after the routing policy change this morning. p50/p95 look fine.
kevin: which policy change? the new graceful-fallback routing?
anya: yes. we shifted fallback weight from 20% -> 50% for low-priority tenants to avoid throttling. p99 jumped ~150-250ms for some routes.
sami: is the spike coming from the fallback origin specifically? can we break down by origin in the console?
anya: I sliced by origin tag (primary/fallback) and cache_hit. fallback+cache_miss shows the worst tail. primary is stable.
judy: do we have sample counts for fallback? small N can make p99 jumpy.
anya: fallback sample count for the window was ~140 requests. total ~900.
kevin: smallish indeed. also fallback runs variant B (smaller GPU) and no local kvcache, so cold misses explain extra latency.
sami: deploy-bot: any recent changes to fallback pool?
deploy-bot: rollout: fallback-pool: variant-b deployed at 6790009000. no config flags changed.
judy: I think we need two things: (A) dashboard change to surface origin-level percentiles + sample counts, (B) a short-term alert to avoid noisy p99 alerts when small origins dominate.
kevin: agreed. on (A) UX idea: add a compact origin breakdown under each percentile: p50/p95/p99 followed by tiny tag showing origin names and counts, expandable to see per-origin percentiles.
anya: that would help developers immediately see whether a tail is concentrated in fallback.
sami: (B) alert proposal: only fire p99 regression alerts when total_sample_count > 500 OR when the delta is > 200ms and the concentrated-origin sample_count > 300. Otherwise send a low-priority noise event.
judy: minor tweak: include origin_concentration_ratio > 0.45 as a condition so we don't suppress real incidents where tail is across origins.
kevin: sounds reasonable. also add a tooltip explaining why p99 can change under routing changes (sample origin shift) and link to the rollout checklist.
anya: can someone draft the alert rule? I'll prototype the dashboard card in staging.
sami: I'll open the alert PR. Pseudo:
```
if (p99_now - p99_baseline) > 100ms && origin_ratio > 0.45 && total_count < 500:
  create_low_priority_noise_event()
elif (p99_now - p99_baseline) > 100ms && total_count >= 500:
  fire_incident_alert()
```

kevin: one more ops note: infra may be able to pre-warm kvcache when ramping fallback weight, but need to confirm cost. I'll talk to infra about a light pre-warm option for rollovers.
deploy-bot: trace-sample: trace-1b7c shows cold-kv latency spikes during fallback requests.
anya: okay next actions: sami -> alert PR, anya -> dashboard card in staging, kevin -> infra check for kvcache warm-start. judy -> add tooltip copy and rollout doc link.
sami: PR opened: https://git.internal/alerts/PR-482 :thumbsup:
anya: invited reviewers on staging card. thanks all. leaving thread for follow-ups.
